image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed restaurant menu. The menu features a beige background with red and black text. It is divided into sections with headers like 'Chicken', 'Beef', and 'Pork'. Each section lists dish names in English and Chinese, prices, and small thumbnail photographs of the food items. A pair of wooden chopsticks rests on a black holder in the bottom left foreground.

artifact_observations.location: Body text paragraphs under item titles
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the headers ('CHICKEN', 'BEEF') and prices are legible, the smaller description text exhibits 'lorem ipsum'-like behavior or slight character fusion/morphing typical of AI generation. It mimics the shape of text but lacks perfect orthographic integrity upon close inspection.
The food images have a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth texture compared to realistic photography. Edges of the food items bleed slightly into the white background of the thumbnails.

The geometry of the chopstick rest and the tips of the chopsticks is slightly ambiguous. The contact point between the wood and the black holder lacks sharp definition, appearing slightly fused or melted.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. AI often generates plausible-looking headers but fails at small body text. If the image_text_auditor finds that the body text is nonsensical or characters are malformed, this significantly impacts the quality score despite the overall layout looking correct. Also, verify if the food images look like real photos or AI approximations.
